description: This file is a Makefile fragment for OpenWrt build system, defining build rules, variables, and functions for building firmware images, root filesystems, kernel images, and device profiles.

methods.name: Image/BuildKernel/MkuImage
methods.description: Builds a kernel image using mkimage with specified architecture, load address, entry point, and kernel file.

methods.name: Image/Build/squashfs
methods.description: Builds a squashfs image, optionally gzipped, with padding for filesystem sizing.

methods.name: Image/Build/gzip
methods.description: Compresses images using gzip, if enabled.

methods.name: Image/Build/targz
methods.description: Creates a tarball of the root filesystem with optional timestamp.

methods.name: Image/Build/cpiogz
methods.description: Creates a cpio archive gzipped, for initramfs images.

methods.name: Image/Build/DTB
methods.description: Builds device tree blob images from DTS files.

methods.name: Image/mkfs/jffs2
methods.description: Builds a JFFS2 filesystem image, with padding and marker.

methods.name: Image/mkfs/ubifs
methods.description: Builds an UBIFS filesystem image with specific options.
